blurb: Salty Native Charters offers customized private charters for fishing, eco tours, shelling, and dolphin watching in Southwest Florida's inshore waterways. Captain Jay, a U.S. Coast Guard veteran, provides safe and professional service tailored to families and anglers of all skill levels. Trips explore local ecology, wildlife, and prime fishing spots around Cape Coral, Fort Myers, Sanibel, and Captiva.
